description:
China is building a massive airport on a manmade island in the middle of the ocean. Engineers are literally moving mountains right now to make it work. But will it be stable enough? Or will it face similar problems as Japan's Kansai Airport, which is sinking right now? 

Today we’ll uncover the story behind Dalian Jinzhouwan Airport.
